We introduce the Continuum Physical Dataset (ContPhy), a novel benchmark for assessing machine physical commonsense.

ContPhy complements existing physical reasoning benchmarks by encompassing the inference of diverse physical properties, such as mass and density, across various scenarios and predicting corresponding dynamics.
